entities.summary: The Battle of Jahra occurred on 10 October 1920 during the Kuwait–Najd War, pitting Sheikh Salem Al-Mubarak Al-Sabah, the ruler of Kuwait, against the Ikhwan forces led by Faisal al-Duwaish, the sheikh of the Mutayr tribe. The confrontation took place in the village of Al-Jahra, located west of Kuwait City. The battle resulted in a costly defeat for the Ikhwan, who failed to capture Jahra village. Sheikh Salem, along with some of his forces, took refuge in the Red Palace, where they fortified themselves.
